TotalNumberOfInstalments.name: Total Number Of Instalments
TotalNumberOfInstalments.definition: Total number of times the amount must be invested at the predefined frequency as of the start date of the investment plan.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Minimum amount of the periodical payments. (If there is no maximum, then '0' must be specified for the Amount or Units.)

PlanContinuation.name: Plan Continuation
PlanContinuation.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to continue the savings plan after the end date.

AdditionalSubscription.name: Additional Subscription
AdditionalSubscription.definition: Indicates whether it is possible to subscribe to additional instalments over and above that permitted by the savings plan frequency.

AdditionalSubscriptionFunction.name: Additional Subscription Function
AdditionalSubscriptionFunction.definition: Indicates whether any additional instalments will reduce the period of the life of the savings investment plan.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the investment plan.

InvestmentPlanRule.definition: If PlanType/Code is not INVP the AdditionalSubscription and AdditionalSubscriptionFunction must not be present.
